purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.success: Host numerical+structural qualification passes, then frozen device qualification passes without threshold relaxation or CPU fallback.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: If exact/equivalent numerical-topology recovery becomes causally exhausted, switch to learned residual / wider multi-block or full-Vocos student / qualified-surrogate route.

L1_PHASE.goal: Host numerical recovery: reduce full47 max_abs from current 0.0004115104675292969 to <=0.0003 while preserving semantic gates and protected-data boundaries.
L1_PHASE.exit_success: Numerical gate passes -> stop search and enter host structural qualification.
L1_PHASE.exit_stall: After the closed tree mechanism, allow by default at most one genuinely distinct evidence-backed exact/equivalent family; if it also fails material progress, activate L0 contingency.

L2_MECHANISM.name: POST_TREE_FRESH_CAUSAL_RELOCALIZATION
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: Current-best boundary taps show block5-7/final stages primarily amplify a dangerous residual direction already present at block5 input Add19. The remaining primary source must be localized upstream before any final exact/equivalent family is justified.
L2_MECHANISM.mechanism_budget: Diagnostic phase only. Do not create candidates while the upstream source is unresolved. After localization, at most one causally distinct exact/equivalent family is permitted by default.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: Identify the earliest upstream residual boundary/block whose intrinsic backend error materially creates the final-sensitive direction, with nonperturbing full-graph evidence and plausible leverage toward the remaining ~27.1% max gap.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_failure: If no credible distinct exact/equivalent upstream mechanism is supported, activate the learned-residual/wider-student/qualified-surrogate contingency rather than micro-tuning.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Which of ConvNeXt blocks0-4 first injects the dangerous residual direction that is already present at Add19 and later amplified into the warm18 final max failure?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Add read-only outputs at residual boundaries Add3/Add7/Add11/Add15/Add19, require final spec_real/spec_imag bit-exact observer-effect PASS, then compare QNN2.44 vs candidate-own ORT1.27 on the same frozen six diagnostic inputs. Use clean ORT suffix propagation and per-block intrinsic closure to separate upstream propagation from new backend injection. No candidate selection occurs in this experiment.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: Identify the earliest materially final-sensitive intrinsic source among blocks0-4, or prove the dangerous direction is already present before block0 and continue one level earlier. No optimization family is opened by raw tap magnitude alone.

L4_ACTION.action: Materialize a current-best tap graph exposing Add3/Add7/Add11/Add15/Add19; run the same frozen six diagnostic inputs; require final outputs bit-exact to untapped current best; then perform QNN-vs-ORT boundary scoring, clean suffix propagation and blockwise intrinsic closure.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: The downstream localization showed the dominant final-sensitive error is already present before block5. This action moves causally upstream rather than enumerating another optimization family.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_every_scored_experiment: Re-evaluate L3 against L2 before choosing another action.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_family_closure: Return to L2; do not create a sibling family automatically.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_two_consecutive_nonmaterial_experi: Stop mechanism-level tuning and perform causal re-localization.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.when_expected_leverage_is_small_relative: Do not spend a family on micro-tuning; justify a mechanism with plausible leverage or change route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_one_additional_distinct_exact_fami: Return to L1/L0 and activate learned/student/surrogate contingency unless new causal evidence materially changes the model.

preflight_questions: What parent task does this action advance?
What causal mechanism makes it capable of material progress toward the remaining gate gap?
What result closes this experiment or mechanism?
What protected data must remain unseen?
If it fails, which parent level do we return to instead of adding variants?
